summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated sibling bundle at install time
details: The package's `preinstall` script `setup.mjs` downloads the Bun runtime (pinned v1.3.13) from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases page, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a package-local file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a 720 KB Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) with string-array rotation and hex-named identifiers, and is not referenced from the package's advertised entrypoint (`index.js`/`lib/index.js`). The advertised purpose of the package is a precompiled libphonenumber wrapper, which has no need for a second JavaScript runtime or an obfuscated auxiliary bundle. The install-time flow smuggles in an alternate runtime whose only role is to execute a bundle that Node-based tooling never loads, and the executed bundle is obfuscated so its behavior is not visible without dynamic analysis. Installation of this version therefore causes attacker-controlled code (the obfuscated Bun bundle) to run on the installing developer's or build system's machine on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
